name: Bon bon Cai Nuoc
summary: Dưa bồn bồn Cái Nước is pickled bồn bồn, the cattail of Cái Nước. It is a collective trademark and a jar to eat with rice or carry home.
origin: Cái Nước. The Intellectual Property Office recognized dưa bồn bồn Cái Nước as a collective mark held by the district farmers' association, and bồn bồn Cái Nước sits among the same marks.
howToEat: Eat it with rice, or carry a jar home.
seoTitle: Bon bon Cai Nuoc — pickled cattail
seoDescription: Dưa bồn bồn Cái Nước is the pickled cattail of Cái Nước, a Cà Mau collective trademark to eat with rice or carry home.
